author: NKS Hub
name: Textida plugin
description: A plugin for the Textida editor in C#: a NativeAOT program on the plugin SDK with a command that edits the document, a manifest, and a test project that replays editor events against it.

pluginId.description: The id of the plugin: dot-separated lower case segments, such as acme.formatter. It may not start with nks.

sdkVersion.description: The version of the packages NksHub.Textida.Plugin.Sdk and NksHub.Textida.Plugin.TestHost.
